fusions.name: Couched Charge
fusions.desc: Rushes up to 7 tiles at the target behind your lowered shield, dealing 32 damage. It always lands as a critical hit.

fusions.name: Wheel and Bash
fusions.desc: Wheels about, dealing 4 damage with the rim of your shield to every enemy within 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Ride Under Guard
fusions.desc: Reduces the damage you take by 20% for 12 seconds, and your movement speed rises by 20% for 6 seconds. It frees you of every root, freeze and slow.

fusions.name: Untiring Guard
fusions.desc: When you spend stamina, you gain a shield worth 6% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
